title: Treatment of Antithrombotic-Associated Intracranial Hemorrhage in Adults: A Focused Guideline Update from the Neurocritical Care Society and the Society of Critical Care Medicine

recommendations.section: Recommendation 1-1 — Spontaneous FXa ICH: PCC preferred to andexanet
recommendations.text: We suggest using 4-factor prothrombin complex concentrate rather than andexanet alfa in patients with factor Xa inhibitor-associated spontaneous ICH (conditional recommendation; moderate certainty evidence).

recommendations.section: Recommendation 1-2 — Traumatic FXa ICH: PCC preferred to andexanet
recommendations.text: We suggest using 4-factor prothrombin complex concentrate rather than andexanet alfa in patients with factor Xa inhibitor-associated traumatic ICH (conditional recommendation; very low certainty evidence).

recommendations.section: Recommendation 2-1 — Spontaneous IPH, antiplatelets, no surgery: avoid platelets
recommendations.text: we suggest against administering platelet transfusions to patients with spontaneous intraparenchymal hemorrhage taking antiplatelet agents who do not require neurosurgical intervention. (Conditional recommendation, low certainty of evidence).

recommendations.section: Recommendation 2-2 — Spontaneous IPH, aspirin, surgery: give platelets
recommendations.text: we suggest administering platelet transfusions to patients with spontaneous intraparenchymal hemorrhage who were on aspirin therapy who require neurosurgical intervention (Conditional recommendation, very low certainty evidence).

recommendations.section: Recommendation 2-3 — Traumatic ICH, antiplatelets: no recommendation
recommendations.text: we make no recommendation regarding administration of platelets for patients with traumatic intracranial hemorrhage who were on antiplatelet therapy.

recommendations.section: Recommendation 3-1 — Antiplatelet-associated ICH, DDAVP: no recommendation
recommendations.text: we make no recommendation regarding use of desmopressin in patients with intracranial hemorrhage on antiplatelet therapy.

recommendations.section: Recommendation 4-1 — Small IPH, anticoagulant reversal: no recommendation
recommendations.text: we cannot make a recommendation regarding treatment of anticoagulant effects in patients with small intraparenchymal hemorrhage due to lack of evidence.

recommendations.section: Recommendation 5-1 — Traumatic ICH: viscoelastic-assay-guided treatment if available
recommendations.text: we suggest using VHA-guided management in patients with traumatic intracranial hemorrhage, when VHAs are available (conditional recommendation, very low quality evidence).

coverage.scope: All eight numbered recommendations in the focused update; other 2016 reversal topics are not replaced by this update.

sourceReview.scope: Source wording, grading and publication updates were compared at the available source depth. This is not certification of comprehensive current clinical guidance.
sourceReview.currencyNote: Identified extraction defects have been repaired. Selected later evidence is labeled separately in dated current-evidence notes; absence of an update note does not establish comprehensive clinical currency.
sourceReview.sourceEditionNote: Attributions retain the original publication identity. The source-access description and individual correction notices define the edition limits.
sourceReview.sourceAccess: Full primary publisher HTML, including recommendations, native GRADE strength/certainty and remarks; retrieved September 30, 2026. No later indexed notice identified at the review cutoff.
